what: Re-judge of the 140-round quickstart log with the decision panel at --concurrency 8, at evaluatorq's default cap of 10 in-flight judge calls and with the cap raised to 48. Wall time is the whole process (uv startup included). A lost vote is a judge vote with completed=false; every one here was pplx-decider-v1-27b answering 429. Decided rounds are the CLI's 'decisive' count.
command_cap10: orq-arena rejudge examples/quickstart/battles.jsonl --config docs/research/configs/quickstart_decisions.yaml --judge-api decisions --judge typesafe/jev-latest --judge perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b --judge openai/gpt-6-luna --concurrency 8 --output OUT.jsonl --report-json OUT.json
command_cap48: uv run python scripts/rejudge_cap.py 48 rejudge ...same arguments as command_cap10 (runs 3 and 4 used the script for both caps)
count_lost_votes: sum(not v['completed'] for line in open('OUT.jsonl') for v in json.loads(line)['judge_votes'])
notes: Runs 1 and 2 ran back to back; runs 3 and 4 in reverse order with 90 s pauses before each, so the rate-limit window from a previous run does not explain the gap.
